methods.numbering: Existing pinned immunum 1.3.0 via numberVhhForLeakage, H chain IMGT, minimum confidence 0.5; raw residue map independently obtained from same pinned annotator.
methods.spanConvention: IMGT engine queryStart/queryEnd are zero-based inclusive; separately reported full-sequence spans and residue positions are one-based inclusive.
methods.alignment: Existing frozen global Needleman-Wunsch affine-gap BLOSUM62; gap open -10, extension -1; all alignment columns including gaps in identity denominator. Reported IMGT-position mismatches are explicit residue-mapping differences, not the traceback of that sequence alignment.
methods.terminalResidues: Prefix and suffix outside numbered domain are sequence facts; no construct or tag role inferred.

interpretation: The two newly screened NB6 entities have exactly identical deposited full sequences.
6VI4 Nb6 is the closest local development reference under the recorded variable-domain alignment.
The candidate and 6VI4 have identical CDR1, CDR2 and CDR3 sequences, with three substitutions in the IMGT framework-2 region and different terminal residues outside the numbered domain.
This is a positive sequence-threshold review signal against an existing development reference, not by itself formal parentage, direct binding, construct clearance or entry exclusion.
Nb39-related local development references 5C1M and 6B73 are compared explicitly; no Nb39 identity is inferred from a nanobody name.
